You're handling most of it alone

expected.planIntro: This feels like a lot right now. We'll start small: one short step at a time.
whatWeHeard: Mom was diagnosed in the last few months.
You're handling most of it alone, and you work full-time.
What worries you most: knowing what to say and legal papers and money.

beforeAfter.before: The diagnosis came with a brochure, and you don't know what to say when Mom asks the same question again and again.
beforeAfter.after: You have phrases that work, practiced out loud, key papers on track, and a plan your family can see.

modules.title: Talking with Mom
modules.reason: Everyone starts here. Talking with Mom comes up every day, from the first weeks on.

modules.title: While she can still decide
modules.reason: Because some of Mom's key papers are missing, and it's easier to sort them out while she can take part.

modules.title: Hard moments
modules.reason: Because you said evenings are hard. This module starts with the trigger behind them.

modules.title: Caring for yourself
modules.reason: Because this feels like a lot right now. Small breaks help you keep going.

modules.title: Safe home, calmer days
modules.reason: Because a quick room-by-room check helps at Mom's age.

modules.title: Getting more help
modules.reason: For when Mom needs more help than you can give alone.

modules.title: Later stages
modules.reason: Comfort, connection and the conversations families need, when the time comes.

loaderLines: Starting with how to talk with Mom…
Moving papers up, while Mom can take part…
Adding the hard moments you mentioned…
Setting the pace to fit your day…

pace.label: About 10 minutes a lesson, 4 lessons a week
